evals.prompt: I want to build a TOML parser in MoonBit. It should parse TOML 1.0 files and serialize them back to TOML strings. Target platform is native only.
evals.expected_output: MoonBit project with TOML parser: plan/ (requirements + architecture), scaffold/ (skeleton), implement/ (TDD), verify/ (gate passed), evaluate/ (README + CI)

evals.prompt: 帮我写一个 MoonBit 的 CLI 工具，用来统计目录下所有 .mbt 文件的代码行数。需要支持递归子目录和排除 _build 目录。
evals.expected_output: MoonBit CLI project: plan/ (CLI 参数设计), scaffold/ (cli 骨架), implement/ (TDD), verify/ (gate passed), evaluate/ (README + CI)

evals.prompt: I need to wrap a C library called libfoo in MoonBit. It has about 20 functions for image processing.
evals.expected_output: MoonBit native FFI binding project: plan/ (四层 FFI 架构), scaffold/ (c-ffi 骨架), implement/ (从 L0 向外写), verify/ (gate passed + ASan optional)

evals.prompt: I wrote a MoonBit JSON parser but it's failing on nested objects. The error is 'type mismatch: expected Object but got Array'. Help me debug this.
evals.expected_output: Debug built into implement: collect failure info, classify, diagnose, fix, re-verify. 3 attempts max then ask user.

evals.prompt: I just finished implementing my MoonBit package. Check if it's ready for publishing.
evals.expected_output: verify/ gate (fmt + check + test + info + moon-audit) → evaluate/ (README.mbt.md + CI + publication checklist)

evals.prompt: Review my MoonBit HTTP server code for security issues.
evals.expected_output: verify/ runs moon-audit pipeline, reports CWE findings (CORS, XSS, CRLF injection, Cookie attributes), auto-fixes where possible
